What We Do

Our Roofing Services

From a few slipped slates to a full re-roof, every job gets the same care.

New Roofs and Re-Roofs

Stripped back and re-covered with new membrane, battens and tiles or slate, built to last.

See more

Roof Repairs

Slipped slates, leaks and worn chimneys found, fixed and made watertight again.

See more

Flat Roofs

Watertight flat roofs for extensions, garages, dormers and porches.

See more

Fascias, Soffits and Gutters

New uPVC fascias, soffits and guttering, so rainwater runs off the roof and away from the walls.

See more

Storm Damage

Slates and tiles lifted or broken by high winds, made safe and put right.

See more

Repointing and Roof Cleaning

Chimneys and ridges repointed, and moss and lichen cleared so the roof sheds water properly.

See more

Smart Roofing

Why Choose Stormwise Roofing and Building

Smart roofing makes for stronger homes. Every job is quoted honestly, done properly and left tidy.

  • Free, Honest Quotes

    We look at the roof itself, explain what it needs in plain English and put the price in writing.

  • Clear Communication

    You know when we are arriving, what is happening each day and when the job will be finished.

  • Done Right First Time

    Proper materials and careful work, so the roof is not back on your list next winter.

  • Tidy Sites

    Sheeted down, cleared up and the drive swept before we leave.

  • Local to Lancaster

    Based in Lancaster and working across the surrounding towns.
